sensitivity.note: Each block varies one parameter family, the rest at central values; exit side (execution + carry forgone) unchanged. Point comparison on central values (no bands). Upper p multiplier = all-incident base rate / cohort base rate.

assumptions: Central expected loss = V(1 - prod(1 - p_i x LGF_i x T_i)): exact ONLY under independent failures + best-path transmission; bracketed by dependence-free bounds [V max p_i h_i, V min(1, sum p_i h_i)] and a parameter band (decision.loss_band). VaR95 from a Monte Carlo (20,000 draws, seed 0). A correlated joint scenario is reported.

Loss reaching the position = loss-given-failure x best path transmission; edge transmissions are expert weights. Loss-given-failure of exploit-type dependencies (issuer, underlying, Pendle, Morpho, oracle) is calibrated on the same DefiLlama incidents as their failure rate: mean share of TVL lost (bootstrap 95% CI as the band); chain and look-through what-if severities remain assumptions; stablecoin depth is measured on price history.
Failure priors: DefiLlama hack history restricted to the protocol cohort (TVL >= $10M), adjusted by audits/TVL/age; stablecoins use their own DefiLlama price history (depeg = price < $0.98).

Position size is an input (default $1M) on a real, live market. Default mode = unlevered exposure (no debt, liquidation NOT_APPLICABLE); borrower=0x..|auto analyses a real Morpho borrower (debt, HF, liquidation) on-chain.

Exposure role decides which failures can reach the position: without debt, the market oracle and the Morpho market act only on borrowers (liquidation) and lenders (bad debt), so they carry no loss to the collateral; the PT's own contracts, its underlying / issuer, the Morpho Blue singleton holding the collateral and the chain do. The Pendle AMM is the exit route: its failure raises the exit cost (stressed exit liquidity), not the redemption value.
Scenario losses are CONDITIONAL on the shock happening (p = 1); the baseline STAY loss is probability-weighted.
Stressed exit: slippage scales with 1 / liquidity factor (liquidity crisis = liquidity x0.5).

Exiting forgoes the PT excess carry: V x (PT implied APY - USDC supply APY on the same Morpho market) x H/365, added to the exit side with a +-50% band; if unknown it is excluded and confidence is downgraded. The same exit side (execution + carry) is used by the headline margin, break-even, scenarios, stress table, sensitivity and book.
Verdict: EXIT if loss_low > exit_high, STAY if loss_high < exit_low, else REVIEW (lean = point comparison). Stale (quote > 60 s, chain state > 120 s), replayed or approximated inputs force REVIEW.
Ethereum: structural assumption: loss-given-failure 30% for role 'chain' (priors.LGF)
